events.title: Midnight Library Power Outage
events.description: You're hitting the books at Fisher Library at 11pm when a thunderstorm cuts the power. Darkness swallows the stacks, and your laptop battery is at 6%. Time for some creative study solutions.

choices.text: 📱 Study by phone flashlight and hope your eyes survive
choices.result_text: You squint at your screen, your retinas burn, and the autocorrect turns 'hypothesis' into 'hippopotamus'. Your essay is... unique.

choices.text: 💤 Improvise a pillow fort and nap on the library couch
choices.result_text: You wake up three hours later, lights back on, feeling refreshed. You've missed the chance to finish the chapter, but you're well-rested.

choices.text: 🚗 Call a classmate to share an Uber home and rant
choices.result_text: You vent about your supervisor and the storm. Your classmate buys you a late-night bubble tea. Friends made!

events.title: Awkward Barbie Banter
events.description: At an Aussie backyard BBQ, you try to compliment the host's meat pie but accidentally call it a 'lovely little meat blanket'. Silence falls. The dog looks at you funny.

choices.text: 😂 Laugh it off and ask them to teach you real Aussie slang
choices.result_text: The group cracks up. You learn 'stubby', 'sanga', and how to say 'sick c***' in a friendly way. You've made mates.

choices.text: 🤔 Double down and insist it's an ancient international-student proverb
choices.result_text: Everyone stares. You later cry in the Uber while the driver plays Ed Sheeran. The 'meat blanket' legend lives on.

choices.text: 🧀 Escape to the esky and offer to get everyone drinks, hiding
choices.result_text: You hide by the esky, stress-eating Tim Tams. The host later finds you and challenges you to a Vegemite spoon showdown tomorrow, as retribution for the 'meat blanket'.

events.title: The Washing Machine Coin Heist
events.description: Your building's laundry room demands $4 in coins, but you only have a crisp $20 note and the change machine has a handwritten 'OUT OF ORDER' sign that's been there since 2019.

choices.text: 💰 Scavenge your flat's couch cushions for hidden treasure
choices.result_text: You find $3.80 in shrapnel, a stale Cheezel, and a 2018 library receipt. Close, but not enough. You wear a slightly damp towel as a toga.

choices.text: 🧋 Do laundry at a friend's place, bribing them with bubble tea
choices.result_text: Your friend agrees, you gossip about group projects, and you get clean clothes. Worth the $12.

choices.text: 👃 Febreze the dirty clothes and hope for the best
choices.result_text: You spray enough Febreze to fumigate a crime scene. Your group project partner sniffs audibly but says nothing.

events.title: Magpie Swooping Season
events.description: You're walking to campus when a territorial magpie decides your head is its personal punching bag. Locals are sprinting past with bike helmets held high like gladiators.

choices.text: 🚴 Zip-tie googly eyes to your helmet and bike through, fast
choices.result_text: You pedal like a maniac but misjudge a curb, flying over the handlebars. The magpie seems satisfied.

choices.text: 🎵 Walk backwards slowly singing Waltzing Matilda, as the internet advises
choices.result_text: The magpie hesitates, confused, but still gives you a warning peck. You now know the second verse.

choices.text: 🥟 Take a scenic detour through the park, buying a mystery meat pie
choices.result_text: You avoid the magpie and enjoy a suspicious-looking pie that might be possum? The park is lovely though.

events.title: The Mysteriously Generous Tip
events.description: During a busy brunch shift at the café, a quiet customer pays with $50 cash and hands you a note saying 'For your studies, from an ex-international student'. You're stunned.

choices.text: 📚 Keep it and buy that required textbook you've been avoiding
choices.result_text: You purchase the textbook and feel a warm glow. The universe is kind.

choices.text: 🤝 Track down the customer outside to ask if it was a mistake
choices.result_text: You catch them, they smile and say 'You deserve it.' You float back to work.

choices.text: 💖 Split the tip with your coworker who's having a rough day
choices.result_text: You give half to Jess, who nearly cries. You now have a café bestie. Morale +100.

events.title: Group Project Free Rider
events.description: Your group assignment is due in 48 hours. One member has contributed nothing but a blank Google Doc and three memes of a dancing koala. The panic is real.

choices.text: ☕ Do their entire part yourself, fueled by 4 coffees and pure spite
choices.result_text: You submit a masterpiece at 4am, then collapse. The free rider gets an equal mark but you're dead inside.

choices.text: 📧 Confront them calmly with the lecturer in CC and documented evidence
choices.result_text: They grudgingly complete the bare minimum after a stern email. Your sanity is intact.

choices.text: 🗑️ Sabotage by leaving their name off the cover page
choices.result_text: The lecturer notices and deducts marks from everyone for 'lack of teamwork'. The drama is cinematic.

events.title: The K-Pop Karaoke Night
events.description: Your new local crew books a private karaoke room and insists you join their K-Pop marathon. You don't know a single song beyond 'Gangnam Style'.

choices.text: 🐎 Go all-out with Gangnam Style, full horse dance, no shame
choices.result_text: The room erupts. You become a legend, the highlight of their story for weeks. Soju is raised in your honour.

choices.text: 🇨🇳 Counter with a Mandarin power ballad and teach them the chorus
choices.result_text: They butcher the tones but love the melody. Cross-cultural exchange achieved.

choices.text: 🎤 Fumble with the machine and accidentally order 3 jugs of Soju
choices.result_text: The bill arrives and your wallet cries. But after the Soju, nobody remembers the slip-up.

events.title: The Midnight Opal Card Malfunction
events.description: It's 11pm at Redfern station. Your Opal card balance is negative, the top-up machine only takes card, and your bank card is frozen due to 'suspicious activity'—that suspicious activity being you buying 2am kebab.

choices.text: 👵 Politely ask a stranger to tap you on
choices.result_text: A kind grandmother in a Werrington Panthers jersey taps you through. You feel touched but also like a child.

choices.text: 🥷 Leap the barrier like a ninja
choices.result_text: Transport officers materialise instantly. You receive a $230 fine and a lecture about fare evasion. Shame.

choices.text: 🚗 Call an Uber, surge pricing be damned
choices.result_text: You get home safely but your bank balance now resembles a sad face. At least you're warm.

events.title: Lunar New Year Red Packet Surprise
events.description: Your landlord Margaret, a 70-year-old Aussie lady who grows lemons, hands you a red envelope for Lunar New Year. Inside: $88 AUD, because she read that 8 is lucky.

choices.text: 🥟 Host a dumpling-making party and invite the whole floor
choices.result_text: You and your friends make messy dumplings. Margaret joins and brings lemon cake. A beautiful cultural exchange. (Net +$58 after party supplies)

choices.text: 🏦 Save it for a rainy day in your emergency fund
choices.result_text: You stash it in your sock drawer. Financial security feels cosy.

choices.text: 📖 Buy the textbooks you've been avoiding all semester
choices.result_text: You finally own the required reading. It costs exactly $88, so the envelope goes straight to knowledge. You feel responsible.

events.title: Huntsman Spider in the Shower
events.description: You step into the shower, half-asleep, and spot a huntsman spider the size of a saucer meditating on the tiles. It's not venomous, but it's... present.

choices.text: 😱 Scream and sprint out naked
choices.result_text: Your flatmate films your exit and posts it on Snapchat with inspirational music. You're campus famous.

choices.text: 🕷️ Calmly trap it under a Tupperware and release it outside
choices.result_text: You bravely capture it, release it into the garden, and feel like Steve Irwin's spiritual successor.

choices.text: 🚿 Turn the water on and pray it doesn't fall on you
choices.result_text: You slip in panic but emerge clean. The spider disappears down the drain, and you'll never sleep soundly again.

events.title: Cooktop Inferno & Fire Brigade Visit
events.description: You attempt a proper late-night stir-fry, but the wok catches fire and the smoke alarm screams. Within minutes, the fire brigade arrives—auto-response, no joke.

choices.text: 🧹 Frantically fan the alarm with a dish towel
choices.result_text: You silence the alarm, but the entire apartment reeks of burnt chilli. The firemen radio in a false alarm.

choices.text: 👨‍🚒 Apologise to the firemen and offer them charred veg
choices.result_text: They chuckle, give a warning, but the false call-out fee is $173. Your stir-fry is now the most expensive meal.

choices.text: 🤷 Hide in your room and blame the 20-year-old toaster
choices.result_text: The firemen eventually leave muttering about 'international students and toast'. Your landlord emails a stern reminder.

events.title: Plagiarism Scare Email
events.description: You open your inbox to a Turnitin report: '23% similarity detected' in your essay. Your heart plummets. But you know you cited everything properly… right?

choices.text: 😰 Re-read the essay 10 times in a panic, imagining worst-case scenarios
choices.result_text: You lose sleep, but the cited quotes are all fine. Anxiety is the real plagiarism.

choices.text: 📧 Calmly email the tutor with the citations and your original draft
choices.result_text: Your tutor confirms it's all safe. You breathe for the first time in a day.

choices.text: 🙈 Ignore the email and hope it goes away
choices.result_text: You forget for a while, but anxiety lingers in the background like a bad hangover.

events.title: Overtime Shift for Tourists
events.description: Your manager at the souvenir shop asks you to work double shifts this weekend because a huge tour group is coming, and you're the only multilingual staff member available. They offer double pay.

choices.text: 🤑 Grind through 8 hours straight, become a retail machine
choices.result_text: You sell 43 koala plushies. Your feet are destroyed, but your bank account is strong.

choices.text: 😌 Negotiate to work just 4 hours for a premium rate
choices.result_text: You work a manageable shift, bond with a tourist about the importance of UGG boots, and still have study time.

choices.text: 📚 Decline, prioritise your assignment due Monday
choices.result_text: You stay home and finish an essay, but FOMO hits as you see a WhatsApp photo of your coworker holding a koala.

events.title: Scholarship Extension Approved
events.description: You applied for a $300 emergency grant for international students months ago and forgot about it. Today an email arrives: 'Approved'. It's like finding a golden ticket in a Tim Tam.

choices.text: 🏠 Pay this month's rent upfront and breathe
choices.result_text: You transfer the rent instantly. Your landlord sends a heart emoji. Financial stress? Never heard of her.

choices.text: 🏞️ Splurge on a weekend trip to the Blue Mountains
choices.result_text: You book a hostel, hike the Three Sisters, and return with 200 photos and a sunburn. Worth every cent. (Net +243 after trip costs)

choices.text: 💰 Save it all in a high-interest account (0.1%) and feel smug
choices.result_text: You watch the interest accumulate: 3 cents. You feel secure, if not rich.

events.title: The Flatmate's Vegemite Challenge
events.description: Your Aussie flatmate presents a heaped spoonful of Vegemite, glistening menacingly. 'One spoonful, no water. Prove you're fair dinkum.' The gauntlet is thrown.

choices.text: 😋 Down it with a stone-cold face and a thumbs up
choices.result_text: You swallow the salty tar. Your flatmate cheers. You have earned the title 'Honorary Aussie'. Need water.

choices.text: 🍞 Smear it on toast with butter like a civilized person
choices.result_text: They call you a wuss, but you enjoy the umami goodness. You live to fight another day.

choices.text: 😵 Dramatically fake faint on the kitchen floor
choices.result_text: They panic, you 'revive' and escape. Later, they call you a comedic genius. The Vegemite remains untouched.

events.title: Bushfire Smoke Haze Day
events.description: A thick blanket of bushfire smoke turns the sky orange and the air acrid. The health app screams 'HAZARDOUS'. You have a lecture in 30 minutes.

choices.text: 😷 Buy a P2 mask and power through the smokepocalypse
choices.result_text: You trudge to class looking like a dystopian survivor. The mask helps, but you still sound like a 40-year smoker.

choices.text: 📺 Skip class, seal all windows, and binge Bluey
choices.result_text: You miss an important guest lecture, but you learn more about Australian family values from cartoon dogs.

choices.text: 🍜 Order UberEats pho and study from home
choices.result_text: Hot soup arrives. You finish your readings in pyjamas, feeling smug.

events.title: Midnight Essay Extension Request
events.description: It's 11:58pm, the essay deadline is in 2 minutes, and the online submission portal has crashed due to 'unexpected maintenance'. Your carefully formatted PDF is trapped.

choices.text: 📸 Screenshot the error and email your lecturer with desperate politeness
choices.result_text: The lecturer grants a 2-hour extension. You submit at 1:30am, exhausted but legally alive.

choices.text: 🔄 Refresh the page furiously, bargaining with tech gods
choices.result_text: At 3am, the portal revives. You submit with seconds to spare, cursing the digital age.

choices.text: 🌐 Download a VPN, switch regions, and hack the system
choices.result_text: Miraculously, the portal works through the VPN. You submit on time, feeling like a cyberpunk hero.

events.title: The Great Cafe Tip Jar Theft
events.description: During a frantic lunch rush, you notice the tip jar—filled with about $70—has vanished. It was your shift to watch. Your manager is glaring.

choices.text: 💸 Offer to cover the loss from your own tips and wages
choices.result_text: You pay up, feeling noble. Your boss softens, and your coworkers secretly pass the hat to repay you.

choices.text: 🔍 Check the security camera and report to police
choices.result_text: You spot a blurry figure in a hoodie. The thief is eventually caught, but the process drains your evening.

choices.text: 🫥 Pretend you didn't see anything and avoid eye contact
choices.result_text: Guilt gnaws at you. Coworkers whisper. Your reputation as 'the one who let it happen' sticks for weeks.

events.title: The Mysterious 'Bin Chook' Encounter
events.description: You take out the trash and come face-to-face with a massive bush turkey (affectionately called a 'bin chook') excavating your bin like an archaeologist.

choices.text: 🧹 Shoo it away with a broom and a firm 'Oi!'
choices.result_text: The turkey retreats, giving you a look of deep disappointment. You feel like a real Aussie.

choices.text: 🤳 Snap a selfie, then feed it some bread (forbidden)
choices.result_text: Instagram loves it. The turkey returns daily at 3pm. You've accidentally adopted a bin chook.

choices.text: 😱 Scream, slip on a stray banana peel, and fall backwards
choices.result_text: You land in a puddle. The turkey judges you silently. Your flatmate captures the moment for eternity.

events.title: Mystery Care Package from Home
events.description: A battered box from home arrives, covered in customs tape. Inside: chilli crisp, instant noodles, spicy snacks, and a handwritten letter from family.

choices.text: 📞 Call Mum immediately and ugly cry
choices.result_text: You sob for 20 minutes while she tells you to 'eat more vegetables'. You feel homesick but deeply loved.

choices.text: 🥳 Share the snacks with your flatmates and host an international snack tasting
choices.result_text: Your flatmates discover the glory of spicy strips. Cultural exchange and empty packets abound.

choices.text: 🔒 Hoard everything under your bed for emergency comfort
choices.result_text: You have a secret stash for bad days. It feels safe, but a bit lonely.
